selection_rule: Earliest task with satisfied dependencies and activation_gate; no task is implemented merely because this manifest exists. Never silently satisfy integration gates with offline tests.

tasks.title: 固定资产、来源和O/R/W运行清单
tasks.deliverable: 生成真实哈希/MVID/工具版本；保护只读快照；明确实际net9资产。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不恢复整个驱动、不修行为。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 恢复可编译R基线
tasks.deliverable: 锁定SDK、资源、IL对照和必要机械恢复；记录所有恢复差异。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不掺入任何已知缺陷修复。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 创建独立W包与公开API差异清单
tasks.deliverable: 独立assembly/namespace/package，候选pack与依赖隔离，迁移工作树。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不发布NuGet，不假冒官方身份。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 实现不可变配置和能力守卫
tasks.deliverable: 别名单位表、默认值、显式安全策略、哑选项拒绝和脱敏。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不实现全局可变过滤器或空壳高级能力。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 统一会话状态和执行所有权
tasks.deliverable: 唯一session/generation/execution/invocation身份及全部wire入口清单。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不增加MARS、不把每次write锁当完整协议锁。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 加固传输与帧边界
tasks.deliverable: 短读短写、长度/CRC/EOF防御、单次TCP建连、统一期限入口。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不猜协议、不重写全部codec。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 修复TLS和原生资源安全边界
tasks.deliverable: 证书链/主机名校验、拒绝降级、native加载及失败释放。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不默认打包原生库、不发明新cipher。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 接通命令、Reader和EF保存契约
tasks.deliverable: 保留DML+影响行数/键回读；多结果、早关闭、flags与资源。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不Split分号、不改EF SQL绕过失败。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 修复参数与类型精度
tasks.deliverable: 显式类型来源、enum/unsigned/decimal、Guid文本、时间与LOB绑定。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不顺带实现复杂类型和JSON查询。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 本地事务和保存点
tasks.deliverable: Dispose回滚尝试、outcome状态、Save/Rollback/Release标准API及守卫。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不静默降级隔离、不实现伪分布式事务。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 定位隔离级别SaveChanges失败
tasks.deliverable: 输出ADO最小复现矩阵和实证根因；能确定则修复并加最终状态测试。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不能预设服务器不支持或GetSchemaTable是根因。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: R1下游交接与正确性门槛
tasks.deliverable: 形成真实candidate nupkg与EF handoff；分离官方行为/正确契约/改进。
tasks.out_of_scope: 缺数据库不得把release门槛标通过。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 端到端异步调用链
tasks.deliverable: 统一async core，所有声明Async路径贯通，fake transport拒绝同步I/O。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不用Task.Run；不会为已有内存值强行yield。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 取消、期限和未知结果竞态
tasks.deliverable: 代际取消、deadline、异常分类、AbortPhysicalSession、未知提交不重放。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不猜CMD_CANCLE、不取消后透明重连。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 验证会话复位能力
tasks.deliverable: 实际探测reset范围/权限/状态残留；输出verified reset或discard决策。
tasks.out_of_scope: SELECT1或ROLLBACK不能自动等同完整reset。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 实现DataSource与池容量/复用
tasks.deliverable: 独立池+受控registry、取消队列、代际清理、VerifiedResetOrDiscard。
tasks.out_of_scope: 未验证状态不回池，不能对discard路径吹嘘复用性能。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 流式LOB读写
tasks.deliverable: forward-only流、无Length输入、跨字符分片、父reader生命周期与内存上限。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不CopyTo MemoryStream整字段物化。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 标准诊断与长时故障/资源测试
tasks.deliverable: 低基数可观察性、敏感数据检查、线程/句柄/内存、测试manifest。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不泄漏SQL值，不把skip当pass。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: R3候选包下游与发布材料
tasks.deliverable: 最终nupkg、精确兼容矩阵、EF集成证据、SBOM/来源和回退说明。
tasks.out_of_scope: 只生成候选材料，未经授权不远程发行。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 数组绑定和批次协议探测
tasks.deliverable: 实际RT、边界、结果归属、事务/错误矩阵；支持/拒绝/未知清楚。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不从DbBatch类型或Write次数推导性能。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 实现受控数组绑定
tasks.deliverable: 固定DML模板+分块参数组、显式事务、每行已知状态与失败索引。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不猜单行影响数、不ContinueOnError自动重试。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes
tasks.activation_gate: Array-binding protocol and explicit-transaction semantics verified

tasks.title: 实现经验证的原生DbBatch
tasks.deliverable: 工厂和DbBatch API、结果/参数隔离、事务归属、早关闭及取消。
tasks.out_of_scope: NativeBatch协议门槛不满足则保持禁用，不用for循环充数。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes
tasks.activation_gate: Protocol evidence establishes native multi-command execution semantics and result attribution

tasks.title: R4性能与EF批次交接
tasks.deliverable: 同语义RT/吞吐/分配对照；下游单独批次PR交接。
tasks.out_of_scope: 若声明NativeBatch，必须另外满足T22；不自动变更EF默认链路。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 后续高级能力分项研究
tasks.deliverable: 每次只选择一项：原生取消/FLDR/缓存/HA/ambient/复杂类型/AOT，产出probe与门槛。
tasks.out_of_scope: 不把研究任务混入核心发行，不假报全功能兼容。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes

tasks.title: 独立逆向验证与边界审阅
tasks.deliverable: 从调用者视角误用/取消/超时/事务失败/复位状态污染测试与审阅记录。
tasks.out_of_scope: 实现agent自己的golden和happy path不能替代独立审核。
tasks.implementation_scope: W.DmProvider; downstream changes only by explicit handoff
evidence_required: actual test commands and exit codes
